A [[Shashay]] '''individual''' was a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who crash-landed her [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] circa [[8 BBY/Legends|8 BBY]]. The native [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] repaired the ship and she paid them with an evening of [[Music/Legends|music]]. The natural talent for music of the Shashay [[Species/Legends|species]] was then discovered.
